text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worrying about Wonder Acute, the Trainer 
thought about stopping the intense 
training. However, T.M. Opera O speaks up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't kindness, it was pure 
faint-heartedness. She needed to look her 
opponent in the eye. Pondering those 
words, she headed over to Wonder Acute, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It turns out the reason for her weakened 
state was that she uses a flip phone and 
couldn't use the recommended dietary 
management app.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After getting everything else off their 
chests that they had held back, their 
issues were resolved. Their bond deeper 
than ever, the two head toward the Japan 
Dirt Derby.
